name: Arianna Casellas e Kauê
description: Catch the unique sounds of this dynamic duo as part of the "Concertos na Piscina x Musa" series for a memorable summer night.
longDescription:
On July 11, 2026, RCA - Radioclube Agramonte hosts Arianna Casellas and Kauê, a musical performance presented as part of the "Concertos na Piscina x Musa" series. This event features the collaborative work of the duo, known for their distinct musical styles. The series itself aims to offer live music performances in a relaxed, summer setting.

Attendees can expect an evening of music in an outdoor environment. The performance is part of a series designed for a summer audience, suggesting a casual atmosphere. RCA - Radioclube Agramonte provides a specific backdrop for the event, with the "Piscina" (pool) element indicating a unique setting for the concert.

This is a ticketed event. Further details regarding ticket purchase and availability will be released closer to the date. RCA - Radioclube Agramonte is located in Porto. Specific public transport routes will be confirmed, but the venue is generally accessible within the city.
